validity.researcher_notes: CRITICAL LOCATION ERROR: Sheet records 'Chicago' as end location with 'Virginia' as end state. EIA Aug 2026 release (Historical Projects row 1135) describes the project as 'installation of air inlet chiller systems at compressor stations along the EGTS' PL-1 system' serving 'supply areas in Leidy, PA to Virginia markets'. The start location 'Leidy' PA is correct; the end is Virginia (market/compressor stations), NOT Chicago. This is a fundamental data integrity issue for the row. ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION 2026-09-14: The EIA cell that grounds this is the Project Notes field of the Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1135, which reads in full: 'Provide an additional 25 MMcf/d of natural gas from supply areas in Leidy, PA to Virginia markets via installation of air inlet chiller systems at compressor stations along the EGTS PL-1 system'; the same row carries Beg. State 'PA' and End State 'VA'. That establishes the CORRIDOR (Leidy PA -> Virginia markets) and so refutes 'Chicago', but it names no end town, and the project is not a line at all -- it is air-inlet chillers installed at existing compressor stations, which is also why LengthKnown is correctly 0. So the fix is to CLEAR EndLocation, not to move a place name into it. The prior recommendation proposed EndLocation='Virginia (compressor stations on EGTS PL-1 system)', which is prose in a value cell and is rejected; 'Virginia' is already carried by EndState/Province. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
